thread:
maria: quick thought  small card idea: show a 7-day sparkline for effective unit cost alongside raw token burn. makes it easy to spot where cache warmups / prefetches drove volatility.
todd: love it. customers keep asking "why did unit cost spike yesterday" and the sparkline + breakdown could tell the story. minimal bandwidth on UI.
sam: backend needs to produce two series per-route: raw_cost_per_token and effective_cost_per_token; plus an annotation stream for big cache events (prefetch bursts). how do we want to compress that?
maria: compress as daily aggregates for the dashboard + event markers for anomalies. also surface a mini table: [model_variant, raw_unit_usd, effective_unit_usd, prefreshare_pct].
todd: prefreshare_pct? do you mean percent of tokens served from shared cache vs tenant cache? that would be super helpful to explain cross-tenant noise.
sam: sketch of telemetry we can emit (router->telemetry):
```json
{
  "route": "/v1/chat",
  "model_variant": "rwkv-14b-quant",
  "window_secs": 3600,
  "raw_tokens": 120000,
  "billed_tokens": 48000,
  "shared_cache_tokens": 60000,
  "tenant_cache_tokens": 10000,
  "shared_cache_credit_usd": 0.45,
  "tenant_cache_credit_usd": 0.08,
  "prefetch_origin": "shared",
  "note": "hourly-aggregate"
}
```
maria: nice. UI can compute effective_unit = (raw_cost - (shared_credit+tenant_credit)) / billed_tokens. we should also show a column for "warmup_charge_usd" to account for initial prefetch cost amortization.
todd: how will routing treat this? if effective cost is low because shared cache carried the load, routing might push more requests to that variant and cause the shared prefetch budget to blow up. we need a soft limit metric surfaced in console like `shared_prefetch_headroom_pct`.
sam: agreed. we'll add headroom and a boolean `prefetch_throttled` so console can flag routes. note: headroom should be sampled per-minute and small.
maria: UX: small yellow pill when prefetch_throttled=true with hover text "prefetch budget low for shared cache, avoid aggressive reroutes". also an explainer modal with math.
todd: rollout plan: 1) emit optional hourly-aggregates behind flag, 2) console shows sparkline + pill, 3) route owners get a weekly email with top 5 models by effective_cost_delta.
sam: operational note: storing two credits (shared vs tenant) increases ingest cardinality. to control costs we'll only keep per-hour aggregates for 90 days and roll up to daily thereafter.
maria: tests: write unit tests for amortization rules (how warmup_charge is distributed), and an integration test that verifies UI numbers match ingest pipeline outputs.
infra-bot: ci: telemetry-aggregates -> staging build passed.
todd: ok assigning: sam (telemetry emit + sampling strategy), maria (UX mock + docs), sam+maria (integration test), todd (routing guardrail doc). aiming for canary in 3 weeks. any objections?
maria: no objections. I'll put a short mock in figma and add copy for the pill. tagging @sam for sampling tradeoffs. :sparkles:
